purpose: Record the repository-provider and evidence-freshness boundaries for the read-only PR truth audit without claiming merge, deployment, provider mutation, credential installation, or live production authority.

claims: src/providers/providerFactory.ts must construct the PR audit through the canonical lazy repository-provider path, preserve GitHub App credential preference and project mapping, and fail closed when the configured provider lacks bounded PR audit evidence.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts must expose PR audit evidence only as an optional provider-neutral read capability; consumers cannot infer merge, approval, mutation, or credential authority from this interface.

src/providers/PullRequestAuditEvidence.ts must keep initial/final PR truth separate and model bounded checks, commit statuses, current workflow contexts, reviews, and changed files with completeness metadata so omitted or truncated CI evidence cannot be treated as complete.

src/providers/GitHubAuditRepositoryProvider.ts must observe exact-head check runs and combined commit statuses, collapse superseded workflow executions to the newest run per workflow/event context, preserve bounded recent review evidence, propagate raw provider truncation, and never add GitHub mutation authority.

src/providers/GitHubPrTruthReader.ts must remain a provider-backed MCP adapter only; it cannot import the GitHub SDK, mint or return provider credentials, or bypass the canonical RepositoryProvider project boundary.

src/mcp/github-truth/verification.ts must conflict the audit when the second PR observation changes GitHub's update cursor, preserve outstanding change requests across head pushes, count approvals only when current for the observed head, and report reviewDecision=unknown whenever bounded review history is incomplete.
